assertions.name: distinguishes completed duration, ongoing age, not-started clock and unavailable evidence
does not reuse prior-revision reviews or recognition, or generic updatedAt for hold onset
does not count scheduled unsent time as unresolved outcome age
counts recovery through durable posting, not provider acceptance or worker liveness
measures explicit evidence-request episodes without overlapping repeated requests
does not invent recovery time for an abandoned lease or a rejected outcome lacking completion
times a proven pre-dispatch block separately from an unstarted payment outcome
uses only the request-owned human and configured scope for operational reads
requires current authentication plus matching session and keeps metrics read-only
keeps completed median, ongoing oldest and missing coverage separate
exposes exact event, source and payment-run evidence without relabeling unknown history as current
rejects timing snapshots for another scope, revision, hash or case set
states fixed snapshot and overlapping intervals without invented latency or worker progress
fetches only the authenticated read endpoint and forwards cancellation
reads actual retained review/post/authorization/recovery events and changes no economic state
measures a sequential business route until its final independent vote
binds grouped proposal timing to its frozen source revision and stops an unsent queue at cancellation
matches the held-out key to independently transcribed originals frozen before key access, preserving all104 facts
matches all four immutable PDF bytes to independent hashes and manifest, not filename equivalence
marks superseded and subsequently invalidated human routes unavailable rather than ongoing or fabricated completion
marks a pending proposal unavailable when a new approved policy invalidates its frozen authority
excludes same-run foreign-scope proposal/version rows and rejects retired read identity without economic writes
keeps accepted-but-unposted recovery ongoing, freezes matched completion, and requires distinct return evidence for returned outcome
keeps missing, future and reversed event clocks out of completed/ongoing aggregation while admitting a real zero duration
